title: Ewok Break Time
description: Ewok Break Time after a hard day on the set (front)? That's the indication from this whimsical sketch by Joe Johnston, art director-visual effects for RETURN OF THE JEDI. And did Princess Leia, who got tougher as the trilogy progressed, have a secret? Another flippant and funny Johnston sketch (back) portrays a no-nonsense Leia looking more like a Terminator.
